messages.subject: [Basta-users] Bug in Version 1.9.2, please update to version 1.9.3
messages.subject_clean: [Basta-users] Bug in Version 1.9.2, please update to version 1.9.3
messages.body_plain:
Dear All,

   We just detected a bug in BaSTA 1.9.2 (currently in CRAN) that assigns some times of death to the wrong individuals. In case you are planning to run BaSTA now, you can find attached version 1.9.3 (which should be in CRAN in the next couple of days). Save the file in a folder of your choice, say ''C:/Documents/BaSTAtemp/'' for windows users, and then type on the R console:

    install.packages("C:/Documents/BaSTAtemp/BaSTA_1.9.3.tar.gz", type = "source")

   Best,

   Fernando





Fernando Colchero
Assistant Professor
Department of Mathematics and Computer Science
Max-Planck Odense Center on the Biodemography of Aging
